meta.title: Migrate from Vue CLI (webpack) to Vite build system
meta.body_summary: Migrate Praeco from Vue CLI/webpack to Vite for ~60% faster builds, instant HMR, and modern tooling, with updated component imports and environment variable handling.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot performed Vite migration with claimed build speed improvement; maintainer asked questions and requested retry but PR closed without merge at unknown time.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2464 changed lines across 14 files, this is a large-scale build tooling migration by absolute volume. It is not a small-step perf PR but an infrastructure change. The PR was closed without merge, likely due to maintainer not fully engaging beyond question comments and a request to retry.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer nsano-rururu asked whether Vite runs on port 8080 and if vue.config.js becomes unnecessary; later requested a retry of the pull request. No performance-related review was provided.
review_details.performance_claim: 60% faster builds (50s to 18s), instant dev server, HMR, better tree shaking.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer requested retry without formal approval; PR closed without merge after long inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully migrated a frontend build system across 14 files, demonstrating ability in tooling migration. However, the PR lacked maintainer engagement and was closed without merge, highlighting a process boundary where even correct changes may not be accepted if maintainers are not invested in reviewing or merging.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer commented on configuration details (port, legacy config) but performed no code review of perf changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes build steps and before/after comparison numbers, but no maintainer verification; agent claims self-testing passed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after maintainer's request to retry; no fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced Vite configuration (vite.config.js) for Vue 2 project, updated package.json scripts, moved index.html to root, updated env variables to import.meta.env, added .vue extensions to component imports, and updated SCSS imports.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes are mechanical import updates across components and SCSS; the largest diff is package-lock.json (2143 lines) from dependency changes.
change_trajectory: Initial plan commit (b849f10): no file changes.
Core migration (b464792): added vite.config.js, updated package.json and lock, modified all Vue components and main entry to use Vite-compatible imports and env variables.
Completion (5644e6d): added .env file, .gitignore for .vite, VITE_MIGRATION.md documentation.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot responded that port 8080 is configured in vite.config.js.

review_signals.summary: Asked whether vue.config.js becomes unnecessary after migration.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot responded that vue.config.js is still needed for backward compatibility with testing/linting.

review_signals.summary: Requested a retry of the pull request without specifying reason.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot defended the migration and asked for clarification.

review_signals.summary: Copilot answered all questions and defended migration, noting firewall restrictions for cypress.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with Vite migration and detailed performance claims.
Maintainer asked two configuration questions on Jun 28.
Copilot answered questions on Jun 30 after a request to retry, while also encountering a firewall block for cypress.
No formal review or approval; PR left unmerged and eventually closed (exact close event not recorded).
